name: BEENOS Inc.
summary: BEENOS Inc. operates in the e-commerce business in Japan and internationally. It operates through E-Commerce and Incubation segments. The E-Commerce segment provides overseas forwarding and proxy purchasing services through tenso.com and Buyee; global shopping business through sekaimon; and internet shopping and buy-back business through Brandear. This segment also engages in the liquor mediation business through JOYLAB; and entertainment and global product businesses. The Incubation segment engages in investment and consultation, and pre-monetized startup businesses. The company was formerly known as netprice.com, Ltd. and changed its name to BEENOS Inc. in October 2014. BEENOS Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
